notes: Fixes updates not actually taking effect. The offline cache added in 1.31.0 was serving the previous release's files, so your browser ran one version behind - which is why the Away mode dialog still said it arms the alarm on 1.32.0 even though the fix had shipped. The hub now always asks the server first and falls back to the cache only when it genuinely cannot reach it, and an open page reloads itself once when an update lands. Also: a developer test copy could set off prize announcements on the Alexas; a dev copy can no longer speak or send phone alerts at all. If anything still looks stale right after this update, reload once more - after that it stays current on its own.
